title: Lantern Post

steps.prompt: A village lantern post: a short thick carved wooden post with one big round paper lantern fixed solidly on top, chunky toy-like shapes, no chains, no thin parts. A single object alone, centred, whole object in frame with margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, no ground, no hands, no extra objects. High-end anime fantasy RPG prop art, stylised 3D look with painterly textures, soft cel shading with warm bounce light and cool rim light, carefully designed surface detail, lush bright colours with luminous highlights, only the object described and nothing else on it, original design, no characters, no faces, no photorealism, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: trellis_2_bf16 with shape and texture VAEs and dino_v3_vit_l (Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2), BiRefNet background removal inside the workflow, ComfyUI 0.39.0 built-in nodes

cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_finish_model.py: stood upright, welded, decimated to 2000 triangles, smart UV unwrap, vertex colours baked to a 1024 px texture, scaled so the longest side is 2.6 m, origin at the centre of the base.
notes: Input image: stylekit/golden/f1/con_env_lantern_post.png. The concept image went through TRELLIS.2 (BiRefNet cut-out, shape, texture, remesh, reduce to about 40,000 triangles, unwrap, bake), then Blender reduced it to the budget and re-baked the texture. Measured: source_tris=1998 final_tris=1998 dims=1.040x1.039x2.600 tex=1024. Made for Huskhaven as a small town (decision 0016). Judged from a rendered preview only; not yet seen in the headset.
